condition: Cellulitis of the leg in a diabetic

patient_persona.description: Pak Cik Zainal bin Awang, 58, male, durian and rubber smallholder near Kuantan, Pahang; type 2 diabetes for 10 years. Rough voice, stoic, East Coast Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Wan Farhana binti Wan Ahmad, Malay woman in her 30s, medical officer at a Kuantan health clinic. Friendly, efficient; Malay with English clinical words.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Pak cik, kaki kanan ni bengkak sejak bila?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tiga hari, doktor. Mula-mula merah sikit dekat buku lali, sekarang dah naik sampai betis. Panas, sakit bila jalan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ada luka tak sebelum tu? Kena duri, kena cangkul?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Celah jari kaki ni memang dah lama gatal, pecah-pecah. Saya pakai but getah masa ke kebun.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ha, celah jari tu ada kulat. Kulit pecah, kuman masuk, jadi cellulitis. Jangkitan kulit dan lapisan bawah kulit.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Teruk ke? Kena potong ke? Kawan saya kencing manis kena potong jari.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak, pak cik. Ni belum sampai tahap tu. Temperature 37.8, sugar 13.2. Tak ada nanah, tak ada kulit hitam.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya lukis garisan pen kat tepi merah ni. Esok kalau merah dah lepas garisan, maksudnya tak menjadi, kena datang balik.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh, macam tu. Ubat apa?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Cloxacillin 500mg, empat kali sehari, tujuh hari. Makan masa perut kosong, sejam sebelum makan. Paracetamol untuk sakit.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Empat kali sehari, perut kosong. Susah sikit tu, tapi saya cuba.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kaki ni kena angkat tinggi masa duduk dan tidur, letak atas bantal. Bengkak cepat surut.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kerja kebun macam mana? Durian tengah gugur ni.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Rehat tiga hari dulu, saya bagi MC. Celah jari tu, saya bagi clotrimazole cream, sapu dua kali sehari, jaga kering.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ubat kencing manis saya, metformin, teruskan ya?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Teruskan. Check gula kat rumah pagi petang. Kalau demam tinggi, menggigil, atau gula lebih 20, pergi Hospital Tengku Ampuan Afzan terus.

condition: Cellulitis on IV antibiotics, ward round

patient_persona.description: Mr. Tay Ah Huat, 66, male, retired taxi driver in Klang; hypertension, overweight. Grumpy but cooperative, Hokkien-flavoured Malaysian Mandarin with English and Malay words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Ng Kai Xuan, Malaysian Chinese man in his 30s, medical officer on the morning ward round at Hospital Tengku Ampuan Rahimah, Klang. Easygoing, quick; Mandarin and English.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Uncle，早。今天第三天了，脚怎样？还痛吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好一点了。昨天晚上终于睡得着。红的地方好像没那么大了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 对，我看 line 画的地方，红色已经退了两三公分。Swelling 也少了。Temperature 36.9，没有 fever 了。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那我可以回家了吗？躺在这里很闷。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 差不多了。今天的 blood test，white cell 从 16 降到 10，CRP 也下来了。我们今天把 IV cloxacillin 换成 tablet。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 换 tablet 就可以回家？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 如果今天 tablet 吃了没问题，明天早上可以 discharge。回家继续吃 cloxacillin 500mg，一天四次，再吃七天。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 一天四次那么多？可以一天两次的吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Cloxacillin 就是要四次，因为药效很快就没了。空肚子吃，饭前一个钟头。你设 alarm 就不会忘记。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好啦。医生，为什么我会得这个？我又没有受伤。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 你的脚趾缝有 fungal infection，皮肤破了，细菌就进去。还有你的脚本来就有一点 swelling，血液循环不好。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那会不会再来？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 有可能 recur。所以脚趾缝要擦 antifungal cream，保持干燥。脚肿的话，坐的时候把脚抬高。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 我的 blood pressure 药要继续吃吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 继续吃 amlodipine 10mg。你的 sugar 这几天有点高，出院前我们做 HbA1c，看看是不是 diabetes。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 糖尿病？唉，又多一样。好啦，你们验吧。

patient_persona.description: Mrs. Shanti a/p Govindasamy, 47, female, school administrative assistant in Seremban; penicillin allergy (rash as a teenager). Articulate, a bit impatient, Malaysian Indian English with Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Mohd Hafiz bin Omar, Malay man in his 40s, family physician at a Seremban clinic. Methodical, apologetic when needed; English with Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, I came three days ago for this arm. The antibiotic, erythromycin, I've been taking, but it's still red and makin sakit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Let me see. Hmm, the redness has gone past the pen line we drew. About two centimetres further. Any fever?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Last night 38.3. And the arm very tight, macam nak pecah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The erythromycin is not working well enough. Some skin bacteria are resistant to it. We need to switch.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: But I'm allergic to penicillin, remember? That's why you gave the erythromycin.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yes, I have it in your record. What exactly happened with the penicillin last time?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: When I was sixteen, rash all over, itchy. No breathing problem. My mother brought me to klinik, they gave injection.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: OK. To be safe, we avoid penicillin and cephalosporins. I'll switch you to clindamycin 300mg, four times a day, for seven days.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Any kesan sampingan I must know?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The main one is diarrhoea. If you get watery stools many times a day, or blood, stop and call us. Mild loose stool is common.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK. Should I go hospital instead? Honestly I'm risau.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Right now your BP is 124 over 78, pulse 92. You're stable. But I want to see you again in 48 hours, Thursday morning.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Khamis I can come before kerja.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If the red spreads fast, you get a blister, the skin turns dark, or pain is much worse than it looks, go to Hospital Tuanku Ja'afar terus.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK. And the scratch from my jiran's cat, is that the cause?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Possibly, cat scratches carry bacteria. Keep the arm raised on a pillow, and wear something loose. Jangan pakai gelang or tight sleeves.

patient_persona.description: Rosalinda binti Juslie, 19, female, Murut college student in Tawau, Sabah, recently back from a jungle trek. Bubbly, fast, Sabahan Malay mixed heavily with English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Fung Kah Mun, Sabahan Chinese man in his 30s, GP at a Tawau clinic. Relaxed, teasing; English with Sabahan Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, lepas trekking kat Tawau Hills, kaki saya kena gigit nyamuk banyak. Saya garu, now dah bengkak and merah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Show me. Oh, this one on the shin, merah besar, warm. Ada nanah sikit kat tengah. Since when?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Since Saturday. First just small bite je, then Monday jadi besar. Semalam demam sikit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ini cellulitis, jangkitan kuman sebab you garu sampai luka. Temperature now 37.6. Ada rasa menggigil?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Menggigil tak ada. Cuma rasa panas and berdenyut, especially malam.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: The pus in the middle, I'll clean and drain a bit. Sakit sikit ya. Then I send swab for culture.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Aduh. OK, doktor, I tahan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Done. Antibiotic, cephalexin 500mg, four times a day, seven days. Can take with food, tak payah perut kosong.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Four times? OK. Ada cream juga ke? Kawan saya pakai Bactroban.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: For this size, cream alone tak cukup. You can put fusidic acid cream on the other small scratches, twice a day.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Saya ada exam minggu depan. Boleh pergi kelas?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh, but angkat kaki bila duduk. Tomorrow and Friday, pergi klinik kesihatan for dressing. I write a referral.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK. Saya takut ada parut nanti. My legs dah banyak bekas gigitan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Stop scratching lah, that's the main thing. Next time trekking, pakai seluar panjang and repellent. For itch, cetirizine at night.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Hehe, OK doktor. Noted. Thank you!

patient_persona.description: Mr. Chia Wei Ming, 38, male, electrical contractor in Kajang, Selangor, speaking for his son Jayden, 6. Worried, direct, Malaysian Mandarin with English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Aida binti Rosli, Malay woman in her 30s, paediatric medical officer at a Kajang hospital emergency department. Calm; English-leaning, speaks functional Mandarin mixed with English.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor，我儿子的左眼肿起来，昨天开始，今天早上几乎张不开。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 有没有被蚊子咬，或者受伤？有发烧吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 前几天眼皮有一个 mosquito bite，他一直抓。昨晚 fever 38.5。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Jayden，看我的手指，眼睛跟着动。Good。转来这边，会痛吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 他说不会痛。眼睛看东西也清楚。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 很好。眼睛可以正常转动，不痛，看得清楚，眼球也没有突出来。所以这个是 preseptal cellulitis，感染在眼皮，不在眼眶里面。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 如果在里面就很严重吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 对，那个叫 orbital cellulitis，要住院打 IV antibiotic，有时候要做 CT scan。现在他是比较轻的那种。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那可以回家吃药吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 可以。我开 amoxicillin-clavulanate，Augmentin syrup，他 20 公斤，一天两次，每次 8ml，吃七天。跟食物一起吃。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 一天两次，8ml。好，我记下来。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Paracetamol 也可以给他退烧。明天要回来 review，我要看肿有没有退。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 要注意什么情况马上回来？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 眼睛转动会痛、转不动、看东西 double vision、眼球凸出来，或者很想睡、头很痛，马上来 emergency，不要等。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 明白了。他明天可以上学吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 这个不传染，可是他还发烧，先休息两天。我写 letter 给学校。

condition: Tinea cruris worsened by topical steroid

patient_persona.description: Lans Koperal Azlan bin Mat Isa, 30, male, traffic policeman in Kuala Lumpur; rides a motorbike in thick uniform all day. Embarrassed, low voice, KL Malay with English.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Kevin Tan, Malaysian Chinese man in his 30s, GP at a Kuala Lumpur clinic near a police quarters. Casual, matter-of-fact; Malay and English.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, saya ada gatal kat celah peha. Dah dua bulan. Makin lama makin besar.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh saya tengok? Hmm, merah, tepi dia naik, bentuk macam cincin, merebak ke punggung. Ada sapu apa-apa krim?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada, beli kat farmasi, Betnovate. Mula-mula sapu, OK, hilang gatal. Tapi berhenti je, datang balik lagi teruk.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ha, itulah masalahnya. Betnovate tu steroid cream. Dia hilangkan gatal sekejap, tapi kulat tu makin membiak. Kita panggil tinea incognito.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kulat? Saya ingat alergi sebab seluar.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ni kurap, fungal infection, tinea cruris. Biasa sangat untuk orang yang berpeluh banyak, pakai seluar tebal, naik motor panas-panas.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Memang, saya jaga trafik kat Jalan Tun Razak, panas sepanjang hari.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Stop Betnovate terus. Saya bagi clotrimazole cream, sapu dua kali sehari, sampai dua minggu lepas kulit dah nampak bersih. Biasanya total empat minggu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Empat minggu? Lamanya.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kalau berhenti awal, dia datang balik. Kulat ni degil. Kaki awak pun saya nak tengok. Celah jari kaki gatal tak?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada juga, sikit. Sebab pakai kasut but sepanjang hari.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ha, selalunya kulat dari kaki pindah ke celah peha. Pakai stoking dulu, baru seluar dalam, supaya tak berjangkit ke atas.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh, macam tu. Tuala boleh kongsi dengan isteri?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Jangan. Tuala asing. Lepas mandi, lap kering betul-betul celah peha. Seluar dalam kapas, tukar dua kali sehari kalau berpeluh.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: OK doktor. Kalau tak baik?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Datang balik lepas tiga minggu. Kalau tak berkesan, mungkin kena makan tablet terbinafine. Tapi saya rasa krim ni cukup.

patient_persona.description: Khor Jun Wei, 19, male, first-year engineering student and competitive swimmer in Penang. Relaxed, a bit sheepish, Malaysian Mandarin with English slang.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Lee Mun Yee, Penang Chinese woman in her 40s, GP at a university health centre. Friendly, practical; Mandarin with English terms.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 医生，我背上和胸口有很多白白的 patch，朋友说是 panau，是真的吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 我看看。嗯，一块一块白色的，有一点点 scale，刮一下会掉皮屑。会痒吗？

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 有时候痒，尤其是训练完流很多汗。去年也有，后来自己好了。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 对，这个是 pityriasis versicolor，就是 panau。是皮肤上本来就有的 yeast 长太多，热天出汗就更容易。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 会传染给队友吗？我们都用同一个 changing room。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 不会传染的。每个人皮肤上都有这个 yeast，只是有些人比较容易 overgrow。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那要怎么治疗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 用 ketoconazole 2% shampoo，不是洗头，是洗身体。擦在 patch 上，留五分钟再冲掉，每天一次，洗五天。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Shampoo 擦身体？好特别。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 对，因为 shampoo 容易擦大面积。之后每个月用一次预防，尤其是比赛季节。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 那白色的 patch 多久会不见？我下个月有 competition，穿 swimsuit 很明显。

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Yeast 一两个礼拜就死了，可是颜色要恢复，可能要几个月。要晒太阳，颜色才会慢慢平均。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 几个月？那没办法快一点吗？

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: 没有什么神奇的方法。不要乱用 whitening cream。游完泳马上洗澡，换干的衣服，就不容易复发。

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: 好吧。谢谢医生，至少知道不是什么大病。

patient_persona.description: Ms. Deepa a/p Arumugam, 36, female, staff nurse in Klang who wears closed shoes for 12-hour shifts. Brisk, knows medical terms, Malaysian Indian English with Malay.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Syed Amir bin Syed Hussein, Malay man in his 40s, GP at a Klang clinic. Relaxed, collegial; English with Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doctor, my feet, between the toes so itchy and the skin peeling, white and soggy. Macam dah lama rendam air.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: How long already? Which toes?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: About two months. Mostly between the fourth and fifth toes, both feet. Now got small cracks, pedih bila mandi.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Let me see. Yes, macerated white skin, peeling, cracks. Typical athlete's foot, tinea pedis. The nails look OK?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Nails OK, I checked. I'm a nurse, 12-hour shifts, feet always berpeluh inside the shoes.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: That's the main cause. Warm, wet, closed shoes. Fungus loves it. Have you used anything?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: I tried some cream from the ward, I think it was hydrocortisone. Tak jalan pun.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Steroid cream won't kill fungus, sometimes makes it worse. I'll give terbinafine 1% cream, apply once or twice a day, for two weeks.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Only two weeks? Clotrimazole last time took lama sangat.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Terbinafine works faster for feet. But apply one to two centimetres around the area too, not only the itchy part.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: And the cracks? Takut kena infection.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good thinking. The cracks can let bacteria in, that's how cellulitis starts. Keep them dry. If red and swollen, come back.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Any tips for work? Tak boleh change shoes during shift.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Cotton socks, change halfway through shift if you can. Alternate two pairs of shoes, let each dry for a day. Antifungal powder inside.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: And at home? My suami also sometimes gatal kaki.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Then he should treat too. Don't share towels or slippers, and dry between the toes after bath. Pakai selipar in the bathroom.

condition: Tinea capitis in a child, results review

patient_persona.description: Puan Julia binti Ambo, 33, female, Bajau market trader in Kota Belud, Sabah, speaking for her son Fikri, 7. Warm, direct, Sabahan Malay with a few English words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Jennifer Lo, Sabahan Chinese woman in her 30s, family medicine specialist at a Kota Belud health clinic. Patient, clear; Malay with English terms.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Puan, result kerokan kulit kepala Fikri dah sampai dari makmal. Memang ada kulat, fungus. Kita panggil tinea capitis.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh, kulat. Patutlah rambut dia gugur bulat-bulat, ada sisik putih.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya. Kulat ni masuk sampai ke akar rambut. Sebab tu cream saja tak cukup. Kena makan ubat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ubat makan? Berapa lama?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya bagi terbinafine tablet. Fikri 25 kilo, jadi 125mg, setengah biji, sekali sehari, empat minggu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Empat minggu. Ada kesan sampingan ka?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kadang sakit perut sikit atau rasa makanan lain. Jarang sangat, boleh kena hati. Kalau dia kuning mata atau kencing gelap, stop dan datang.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik. Sekolah macam mana? Cikgu suruh dia duduk rumah.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bila dah mula ubat, dia boleh ke sekolah. Tapi jangan kongsi sikat, topi, atau bantal dengan kawan.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Adik-beradik dia pun tidur satu bantal. Kena check juga?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, bawa adik-beradik datang, saya nak tengok kepala mereka. Kucing di rumah ada?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ada dua ekor kucing. Satu tu bulu dia pun gugur sikit.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Kemungkinan dari kucing tu. Bawa kucing jumpa doktor haiwan. Kalau tak, Fikri boleh kena balik.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Shampoo biasa boleh guna?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Saya bagi ketoconazole shampoo, cuci rambut dua kali seminggu. Ini kurangkan kulat merebak kepada orang lain.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik, doktor. Nanti rambut dia tumbuh balik?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Biasanya tumbuh balik lepas rawatan habis. Kita jumpa lagi empat minggu, check kulit kepala dan ulang kerokan.

patient_persona.description: Encik Jimmy Ngelai, 44, male, Iban oil palm plantation harvester near Bintulu, Sarawak; lives in estate quarters with his family. Deep, easy-going, Sarawak Malay with English words.

doctor_persona.description: Dr. Chai Yee Ling, Sarawakian Chinese woman in her 30s, medical officer at a Bintulu health clinic. Direct, friendly; English with Sarawak Malay.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Doktor, badan saya banyak kurap. Pinggang, belakang, peha. Dah tiga bulan. Saya sapu macam-macam, tak baik.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Apa yang encik sapu?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Ubat kurap dari kedai runcit, yang botol hijau tu. Pastu kawan bagi cream putih, lepas sapu kulit rasa licin.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Cream putih tu mungkin steroid. Tengok sini, the rash is big, merah dengan tepi bersisik, and some areas thin skin. That's steroid effect.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Oh. Saya tak tahu, bah. Saya ingat semua cream sama.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Tak apa. Sekarang kurap dah terlalu luas untuk cream saja. Kita guna tablet terbinafine 250mg, satu biji sehari, dua minggu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tablet ni selamat? Saya ada minum tuak kadang-kadang, hujung minggu.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Good you told me. Terbinafine diproses di hati. So sebelum mula, kita check liver function. Masa makan ubat, stop tuak dulu.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dua minggu tak minum? OK lah, boleh tahan.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Bagus. Result liver test biasanya siap esok. Kalau normal, saya call, encik datang ambil ubat.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Kerja saya panas, peluh banyak. Itu sebab kurap ka?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Ya, peluh dan baju basah lama. Tukar baju kering bila rehat, mandi terus lepas kerja, lap kering betul-betul.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Anak saya dua orang pun ada gatal-gatal. Berjangkit ka?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Boleh berjangkit through towel, katil, baju. Bawa anak-anak datang, I check them. Jangan kongsi tuala.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Baik. Cream putih tu saya buang?

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Buang, or bagi saya tengok dulu. Jangan guna lagi untuk kurap. Kita jumpa dua minggu lagi, see how the skin is.
